The mechanism is not shown inert and MECH-063 remains v3-testable once the burst regulator decays and the warmup leaves headroom; marking it substrate_conditional would suppress GOV-GRAN-1 surfacing and flag the claim not-v3-testable, which overstates the finding. targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-963a (FAIL 2026-09-02) is NON-CONTRIBUTORY, and -- correcting the reading this autopsy first drafted -- the cause is NOT sampling starvation. Two independent, recomputed pillars refute that. (1) THE PHASIC BURST NO LONGER DECAYS. On PHASIC-ON cells the event-tick rate (n_event_ticks/n_e3_selects) is 0.390-0.884 in 963a against 0.007-0.136 in V3-EXQ-779a under the same burst config; seed 23 T1P1 fires on 1489 of 1684 selections. A transient that occupies up to 88% of ticks is a quasi-sustained regime, which is why C2's dominance clause (driver:864-866) fails on seeds 11 and 23 by 5-13x off hundreds of event ticks, and why the one quiescent-tick shortfall (seed 23 T1P1, 195/200) appears at all -- it is a SYMPTOM of the burst never decaying, not a sampling accident. (2) THE WARMED BASELINE HAS NO ENTROPY HEADROOM. T0P0 S_sustained_entropy fell from 0.152-0.610 in 779a to 0.0195-0.153 in 963a, a 3-26x collapse on EVERY seed under the SD-074 warmup. The R5 failure is therefore reproducible and structural across 963 and 963a, not a 4.6e-4 fluke on one cell; seed 17 is the tail of a systematic collapse. The predecessor autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-963_2026-08-30 had ALREADY refuted starvation on the identical 16/20 profile, and this reading now engages that rather than re-charging it. CONSEQUENCE FOR ROUTING: raising MAX_ENV_STEPS_PER_CELL can at best rescue seeds 29 and 37, giving 3/5 against MIN_SEEDS 4 -- the cap bump cannot produce a result. And the counterfactual matters: had seed 17 cleared the 0.02 floor, the driver would have emitted FAIL/weakens on 1/5 dissociating seeds (driver:1041-1046), not a positive. What the run does establish positively is that the 963 probe_warmup repair worked (R3 tonic_axis_live 1.0 on 10/10 TONIC-ON cells). Separately, the label logic (driver:1005-1034) never reads the sampling_shortfall block it ships (computed :1003, stored passively), so the emitted substrate_not_ready_requeue is unreliable in either direction -- and SD-069's what_would_answer had explicitly forbidden that label for a starvation run and prescribed raising the 2400 cap, neither of which the driver honoured.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Phasic burst must decay on a warmed agent, and warmup must leave sustained-entropy headroom
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: Two coupled defects block the MECH-063 (ii) tonic/phasic dissociation and are both regulator behaviour, not sampling. (a) BURST DECAY: with signal_source instantaneous_pe, trigger_ratio 1.2 and decay 0.5, the phasic burst occupies 0.390-0.884 of E3 ticks on a warmed agent (779a: 0.007-0.136), so no transient is separable. Give the burst a carry-mode/refractory decay whose realised duty cycle is bounded and asserted. (b) WARMUP HEADROOM: the SD-074 warmup drives T0P0 sustained entropy to 0.0195-0.153 (779a: 0.152-0.610), pinning the R5 headroom gate at its 0.02 floor reproducibly. Either the warmup must leave headroom or R5's band must be re-derived for warmed agents. Both must be verified BEFORE any further 963-lineage letter.

re_derive_brake.brake_note: FIRES as the 5th hit for MECH-063 (threshold 2). An earlier draft of this autopsy released the brake on the theory that the failure was sampling starvation owing no substrate build; the adversarial pass refuted that and the release is withdrawn. This target owes a substrate build (action: create), so under R3 the instrument carve-out does not apply and the run counts. A V3-EXQ-963b that merely raises MAX_ENV_STEPS_PER_CELL is REFUSED: it can rescue at most seeds 29 and 37, giving 3/5 against MIN_SEEDS 4, and it would leave both regulator defects untouched. A successor is admissible only after the burst is shown to decay on a warmed agent and R5 headroom is restored.

learning_extracted: An event-tick rate of 0.39-0.88 where the predecessor saw 0.007-0.136 is a regime change in the regulator, not a sampling difference; the step-cap shortfall is its symptom.
A 3-26x collapse in baseline entropy across every seed makes a headroom gate fail structurally; reading its worst cell as a 4.6e-4 near-miss inverts cause and tail.
A repaired lever can make a lineage LOOK closer to a result while moving the binding constraint somewhere new -- 963's tonic axis is genuinely fixed and 963a is not therefore nearer a PASS.
Checking the counterfactual is what exposes a false near-miss: clearing seed 17's floor would have produced FAIL/weakens on 1/5 seeds, not a positive.
A self-route label emitted by logic that never reads the shortfall block it ships is unreliable in BOTH directions, not merely biased toward one.
what_would_answer instructions are enforced nowhere: SD-069 named the cap fix and forbade the label, and the successor did neither.
